changelog:
Initial release — provides a comprehensive framework for defining and enforcing a brand voice and style guide.

- Guides users step-by-step through building a detailed brand voice reference, with options to build from existing product marketing context or from scratch.
- Captures brand personality, voice attributes, messaging pillars, tone adaptations by channel and situation, and style rules.
- Uses interactive, conversational prompts and practical tools (spectrums, checklists, anchored examples) to gather precise brand guidance.
- Generates `.agents/brand-voice-guide.md` as a living reference for consistent use by downstream skills.
